prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated production reference for a low-poly 3D prop in a cheerful children's miniature town. Tactile handpainted clay/plastic, soft rounded bevels, clean coherent chunky geometry, warm cream, turquoise, coral and golden-yellow accents matching a miniature toy-town kiosk. Elevated three-quarter front-right view, whole object centred with generous white margin, plain pure white background, soft even neutral studio light, minimal contact shadow. No people, animals, readable text, logos, pavement, grass, diorama, surrounding props or broad ground plate. Simple robust forms suitable for fewer than 4000 triangles and one baked opaque texture; no glass or transparency. Subject: one short friendly public drinking fountain, overall width:height:depth about .7:1:.7. Turquoise chunky tapered pedestal with narrow grounded foot supports one wide shallow warm cream round basin; one small thick curved coral drinking spout rises from the back rim and points down toward centre, with a simple yellow push button molded beside it. Basin visibly hollow and EMPTY, no water jet or puddle. Bowl and pedestal structurally connected, all edges rounded. No pipes to ground, loose parts, sink cabinet, separate faucet assembly, glass or broad baseplate.
reviewNotes: Empty basin with integrated spout and button. Decorative dry asset, no new water interaction.
